entries.title: Evaluation runner, explicit model defaults and separate test configuration
Isolated eval-session construction, prompt transformation and sequential reload steps
Eval cancellation, snapshot-before-disposal and cleanup error aggregation
Strict prompt completion, normalized transcripts and evaluation usage
Task-bound session/source artifacts and scoped attachment persistence
Comparative harness tables, canonical input pairing and failure metadata
Per-test run index, observation extraction and interrupted-run reporting
Paired correctness lift, telemetry availability and diagnostic terminal summaries
Built-in smoke and extension-authoring evaluation scenarios

surfaces.name: .ice
surfaces.notes: Original C002103. Eval fixture expects .ice/extensions/hello.ts inside its temporary project. Native extension paths/ABI alone do not implement this model-authoring evaluation.

surfaces.name: ICE_PROVIDER
surfaces.notes: Original C002109 is the smoke assertion's expected provider value, distinct from runner/default selection in MISC-040.

surfaces.name: ICE_MODEL
surfaces.notes: Original C002110 is the smoke assertion's expected model value; this is not a normal CLI model-default claim.

surfaces.name: ICE_EVAL_ARTIFACT_DIR
surfaces.notes: Original C002113. Reporter trims this value, skips persistence when empty, and uses it as supplied; runner resolution is separately authored under MISC-040.

surfaces.name: npm run eval
surfaces.notes: Private eval workspace runner; root script forwards remaining arguments here.

surfaces.name: eval --provider
surfaces.notes: Separate and equals forms; any CLI model selector requires both CLI values after trimming.

surfaces.name: eval --model
surfaces.notes: Separate and equals forms; missing CLI half is not completed from environment defaults.

surfaces.name: ICE_PROVIDER
surfaces.notes: Trimmed environment provider is used only when no CLI selector was supplied; installed/removed with ICE_MODEL in child environment.

surfaces.name: ICE_MODEL
surfaces.notes: Trimmed environment model is used only with the provider pair; selected harnesses may override both.

surfaces.name: ICE_EVAL_ARTIFACT_DIR
surfaces.notes: Truthy override resolves relative to package root, unlike the reporter's direct trimmed use.

surfaces.name: .eval/<timestamp>_<UUID>
surfaces.notes: Default private eval artifact root. Timestamp colons are replaced; requested mkdir mode0700.

surfaces.name: src/**/*.eval.ts
surfaces.notes: Opt-in model-backed file selection; fileParallelism=false, test120000ms/hook30000ms and two reporters.

surfaces.name: test/**/*.test.ts
surfaces.notes: Separate deterministic helper-test selection; no eval setup/reporter installed here by this file.

surfaces.name: resolveModelSelection
surfaces.notes: Explicit nullish selection before environment fallback; trimming and complete-pair requirement.

surfaces.name: createIceCodingAgentHarness
surfaces.notes: Factory overloads choose string output or JsonValue output callback; name defaults to ice-coding-agent.

surfaces.name: IceCodingAgentInput prompt/reload sequence
surfaces.notes: String prompt or typed ordered prompt/reload steps; at least one prompt required.

surfaces.name: transformSystemPrompt
surfaces.notes: Synchronous complete-prompt transform, nonempty trim validation, then resource reload.

surfaces.name: output({response,session})
surfaces.notes: Awaited custom projection while the live session and temporary files still exist.

surfaces.name: noTools (eval harness option)
surfaces.notes: Forwards CreateAgentSessionOptions noTools; no independent eval tool-policy schema.

surfaces.name: ice-eval-*/workspace
surfaces.notes: Fresh OS-temp project cwd for each run.

surfaces.name: ice-eval-*/agent
surfaces.notes: Fresh agent resource directory with in-memory settings; normal ModelRuntime authentication remains separate.

surfaces.name: ice-eval-*/sessions
surfaces.notes: Native session file is created under the same scoped temporary root.

surfaces.name: runId eval artifact
surfaces.notes: SessionManager session ID identifies attachments and index records; it is not a comparison input key.

surfaces.name: HarnessContext AbortSignal
surfaces.notes: Once-only listener memoizes session.abort(); finally removes listener and awaits it; phase boundaries are explicit.

surfaces.name: snapshot/dispose/remove cleanup
surfaces.notes: Collect snapshot, disposal and rm errors, preserving the primary run error in AggregateError.

surfaces.name: normalized eval events and usage
surfaces.notes: Text/tool projection and selected-model usage/pricing gate; native full session is separately attached.

surfaces.name: strict Stop response contract
surfaces.notes: Only exact stop plus nonempty exposed text succeeds; native Completed alone is broader.

surfaces.name: iceSessionJsonl
surfaces.notes: Snapshot artifact key consumed by explicit-task afterEach registration; unmodified UTF-8 native JSONL.

surfaces.name: @zykairotis/ice-evals:session
surfaces.notes: Typed task artifact with runId and session.jsonl attachment; not a native session schema alias.

surfaces.name: @zykairotis/ice-evals:source
surfaces.notes: Typed task artifact with runId and caller-supplied UTF-8 source attachment.

surfaces.name: recordEvalSessionArtifact
surfaces.notes: Undefined snapshot skips; present snapshot requires string runId/session before recordArtifact(task,...).

surfaces.name: recordEvalSourceArtifact
surfaces.notes: Explicit task/run/attachment registration; no extra runtime validation in wrapper.

surfaces.name: persistEvalArtifactReferences
surfaces.notes: Strict type/run selection, basename check, hashed directories and ordered relative references.

surfaces.name: eval afterEach task-artifact hook
surfaces.notes: Reads task.meta.harness?.run and registers its snapshot before reporters.

surfaces.name: sessions/<SHA-256(runId)>/session.jsonl
surfaces.notes: Session attachment storage, requested directory0700/file0600; duplicate names overwrite.

surfaces.name: sources/<SHA-256(runId)>/<basename>
surfaces.notes: Source attachment storage; host basename semantics and relative returned path.

surfaces.name: evalHarnessTable
surfaces.notes: One baseline, candidate or candidates, positive safe repetitions; declaration order within repetitions.

surfaces.name: deriveEvalGroupKey
surfaces.notes: JSON pair of trimmed explicit ID or canonical-input SHA-256 and repetition.

surfaces.name: vitestEvalsHarnessIteration
surfaces.notes: Version1 artifact records evalSet/groupKey/harness/baseline/candidates/repetition on success or attached partial failure.

surfaces.name: parseEvalHarnessIterationArtifact
surfaces.notes: Type/shape parser is looser than builder validation; numeric repetition need not be finite or positive here.

surfaces.name: EvalHarnessReporter.onInit
surfaces.notes: Stores logger for end-of-run output.

surfaces.name: EvalHarnessReporter.onTestCaseResult
surfaces.notes: Awaited attachment persistence and local JSONL index append when configured.

surfaces.name: EvalHarnessReporter.onTestRunEnd
surfaces.notes: Interrupted run suppresses comparisons; otherwise collects and formats observed runs.

surfaces.name: test.meta().eval.avgScore
surfaces.notes: Finite average judge score is correctness input; run errors outrank it, while test status is fallback only.

surfaces.name: runs.jsonl
surfaces.notes: Append-only per-test run index contains test identity/status, usage, errors/timings and attachment references, not direct judge-score/output serialization.

surfaces.name: HarnessObservation
surfaces.notes: Scored/unscored/skipped/pending/errored observation union with independent optional telemetry.

surfaces.name: HarnessComparisonReport schemaVersion1
surfaces.notes: Per-eval-set candidate comparisons and once-per-group/harness diagnostics.

surfaces.name: summarizeHarnessComparisons
surfaces.notes: Baseline pairing, exact-one eligibility, score>=1 pass rates and finite paired telemetry.

surfaces.name: formatHarnessComparisonReport
surfaces.notes: Percentage-point correctness, signed efficiency deltas, pair coverage and incomplete observations.

surfaces.name: .ice/extensions/hello.ts
surfaces.notes: Fixed source path inspected by the model-authoring judge and attached as hello.ts.

surfaces.name: ExtensionAuthoringJudge
surfaces.notes: Binary score checks canonical imports, loader/tool registration, exact successful hello call and response.

surfaces.name: system-prompt-without-docs / default-system-prompt
surfaces.notes: One-repetition baseline/candidate treatment; exact Guidelines/current-cwd marker slicing and hard setup assertions.

surfaces.name: Ice Coding Agent smoke
surfaces.notes: No-tools Paris response/errors/model identity/token assertions; no comparison iteration metadata.

claims.claim: Evals uses vitest-evals with real AgentSessions in temporary directories and is missing natively.
claims.finding: Confirmed the full model-backed adapter, isolation/reload, snapshot/artifact, comparison-table, reporter and paired-summary behavior. Native AgentHarness, JSONL persistence, abort and deterministic Faux/in-memory tool tests already exist; the missing layer is the eval workflow and comparison/reporting adapter. No real-model outcome was executed.
